notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements to game mechanics
Gameplay mechanics fixes
notes.content: [p]After receiving some feedback and watching some players play, this update v06.06.25 brings improvements and bug fixes.[/p][p]Now, when the player crouches on a spot where the wooden floor creaks, no noise will be emitted.[/p][p]The gas cylinder in the kitchen will reappear after a while, preventing the player from getting stuck in the game if the object is used incorrectly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548880/99cf77ed6c39ce4d763f65ca56c4f8f858ca4040.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: VHS effect
notes.content: The VHS effect can be turned on and off in the game's main menu. The effect is already turned on automatically.
